name: Mohit Kumar
shortIntro: Security Engineer at ITC Infotech working across AI for Security and Security for AI — building an open-source defensive tooling suite, hardening ML & agent supply chains, and running SOC/VAPT and GRC (J-SOX/MICS) audits. Deep ML background in adversarial robustness, multi-agent systems, and detection engineering.
longIntro: I’m a Security Engineer at ITC Infotech, blending deep AI/ML expertise with security operations. I work in two directions at once — AI for Security (autonomous detection tooling and SOC-grade anomaly detection) and Security for AI (protecting models, agents, and software supply chains from attack) — alongside GRC control auditing (J-SOX, MICS). During my internship I built a production multi-agentic email threat-neutralization system; today I maintain an open-source security tooling suite spanning the modern software supply chain, and run VAPT and detection engineering (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk). Before pivoting to security I built production ML systems — Legal AI (HybEx-Law, 98.5% F1), multi-agent research platforms, and computer vision (98.99% mAP). I believe the future of security is AI-native — and the future of AI must be secure.
